elementary school: My little brother started elementary school this year, and he walks there with his friends every morning.
我弟弟今年開始上小學，他每天早上和朋友一起走路去學校。
an elementary mistake: Forgetting to write your name on the test paper is an elementary mistake that even beginners should avoid.
忘了在考卷上寫名字是一個連初學者都應該避免的低級錯誤。
elementary particles: Scientists believe that everything in the universe is made of tiny elementary particles that cannot be broken down further.
科學家相信宇宙萬物都是由無法再分解的微小基本粒子所組成。
elementary knowledge: You only need elementary knowledge of English, such as greetings and numbers, to order food in this café.
你只需要基礎的英文知識，例如問候語和數字，就能在這家咖啡廳點餐。
be eligible for a scholarship: Students with good grades and low family income are eligible for a scholarship that covers their school fees.
成績優良且家庭收入低的學生有資格申請一筆可支付學費的獎學金。
be eligible to vote: In Taiwan, citizens must be at least eighteen years old to be eligible to vote in a referendum.
在台灣，公民必須年滿十八歲才有公投投票資格。
an eligible bachelor: Handsome, kind, and successful, the young doctor was considered the most eligible bachelor in the whole town.
這位年輕醫生英俊、善良又事業有成，被認為是全鎮條件最好的單身漢。
an eloquent speech: The principal gave an eloquent speech at graduation, and many students and parents were moved to tears by her words.
校長在畢業典禮上發表了一場動人的演說，許多學生和家長都被她的話感動落淚。
an eloquent silence: When the teacher asked who broke the window, there was an eloquent silence, and everyone looked at Jack.
老師問是誰打破窗戶時，出現了一陣意味深長的沉默，大家都看向傑克。
an eloquent reminder of: The old bomb shelter in the park is an eloquent reminder of how frightening the war was for local people.
公園裡的舊防空洞有力地提醒人們，戰爭對當地居民來說有多可怕。
an emotional appeal: The charity made an emotional appeal on TV, showing hungry children and asking viewers to donate whatever they could.
這個慈善團體在電視上發出訴諸情感的呼籲，播放飢餓兒童的畫面，請觀眾盡力捐款。
emotional intelligence: People with high emotional intelligence can control their anger and understand how others are feeling.
情緒智商高的人能控制自己的怒氣，並理解別人的感受。
an emotional farewell: There was an emotional farewell at the airport, with hugs and tears, as Lisa left to study in Canada.
莉莎出發去加拿大讀書時，機場上演了一場動情的告別，充滿擁抱和淚水。
emotional support: When I failed the entrance exam, my best friend gave me emotional support by listening and encouraging me.
我入學考試落榜時，我最好的朋友傾聽並鼓勵我，給了我情感上的支持。
get emotional: My grandmother always gets emotional when she looks at old photos of her late husband and starts crying.
我奶奶每次看到已故丈夫的舊照片就會變得激動，開始哭泣。
an energetic campaign: The students ran an energetic campaign against plastic straws, giving speeches and handing out posters all over school.
學生們發起了一場積極有力的反塑膠吸管活動，在全校演講並發送海報。
an energetic performance: The band gave an energetic performance, jumping and dancing across the stage while the crowd sang along loudly.
樂團帶來了一場充滿活力的表演，在台上又跳又舞，台下觀眾也大聲跟著唱。
a thoroughly enjoyable evening: We had a thoroughly enjoyable evening at the night market, eating delicious snacks and laughing with old friends.
我們在夜市度過了一個非常愉快的夜晚，吃美味的小吃，和老朋友一起歡笑。
make learning enjoyable: Our English teacher uses songs and games to make learning enjoyable, so nobody feels bored in her class.
我們的英文老師用歌曲和遊戲讓學習變得有趣，所以在她的課上沒有人覺得無聊。
enormous pressure: Senior high school students are under enormous pressure before the entrance exam and often study until midnight.
高中生在入學考試前承受巨大的壓力，常常讀書讀到半夜。
an enormous amount of: Building the new stadium took an enormous amount of money, time, and work from thousands of people.
興建新體育場花費了大量的金錢、時間，以及數千人的心力。
be of enormous importance: Clean water is of enormous importance to people's health, especially in poor villages without hospitals.
乾淨的水對人們的健康極為重要，特別是在沒有醫院的貧困村莊。
enormous potential: The coach believes the young player has enormous potential and could become a world champion one day.
教練相信這位年輕選手有巨大的潛力，有一天可能成為世界冠軍。
be enthusiastic about the plan: Everyone in the class was enthusiastic about the plan to visit Japan and immediately started saving money for it.
班上每個人都對去日本的計畫很熱衷，立刻開始為此存錢。
an enthusiastic response: The new bubble tea flavor got an enthusiastic response, and the shop sold out on the very first day.
新口味珍珠奶茶獲得熱烈的回應，這家店第一天就賣光了。
an enthusiastic supporter: My uncle is an enthusiastic supporter of the local baseball team and goes to every home game wearing its shirt.
我叔叔是當地棒球隊的熱情支持者，每場主場比賽都穿著球衣去看。
enthusiastic applause: When the young pianist finished playing, the audience stood up and gave her enthusiastic applause for several minutes.
年輕鋼琴家演奏結束時，觀眾起立給她熱烈的掌聲，持續了好幾分鐘。
be envious of someone's success: Instead of being envious of someone's success, you should learn from them and work hard toward your own goals.
與其羨慕某人的成功，你應該向他們學習，並努力朝自己的目標前進。
an envious glance: When Amy showed off her new phone, her classmates gave her an envious glance, wishing they had one too.
艾咪炫耀她的新手機時，同學們投以羨慕的一瞥，希望自己也有一支。
